set.body:
Outcome

Replace the weak fold ontology with sample-axis-bound validation, cross-fit, pairing, and randomization designs.

Acceptance

- Compiled schedule and receipt cannot diverge.
- Coverage is not confused with leakage safety.
- Generalization and exchangeability participate in scientific identity.
- New paths do not use FoldPlan.
- This gate closes only after every Phase 3 child closes.
set.title: P3: bind Resample4s into distinct scientific evidence designs
